Guild.title: Guild
Guild.description: Represents a Discord server/guild and its configurations, analytics, tickets, and logs.

id.description: The unique ID of the guild/server.

icon.description: The icon URL for the guild.

hasBot.description: Whether the bot is currently in the guild.

memberCount.description: The number of members in the guild.

boosts.description: The number of nitro boosts on the guild.

channels.description: List of channel names available in the guild.

analytics.description: Message counts, active users, weekly trends, etc.

leaderboard.description: User experience, levels, and rank leaders.

tickets.description: Support ticket channels and message logs.

guilds/{guildId}.description: Document containing all configuration and live status for a specific guild.
